snippet.title: Kiipluu gameplay video 2
snippet.description:
Gameplay teaser for Kiipluu
Can You Forge a Legacy? Immerse yourself in an untamed Neolithic world as Kiipluu, a young hunter on the brink of adulthood. With his tribe’s survival and legacy at stake, every decision matters. Will Kiipluu rise as a leader, or will the weight of his choices break him?
Wishlist the game now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3826710/Kiipluu/
